summary: Neways Electronics International is innovating electronics for a sustainable future, founded in 1969. Type: listed company. About 1,331 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Brabant-based maker of mission-critical electronics for chipmaking, defence and mobility; IND recognised sponsor with staff of 143 nationalities.

culture.text: Develops and builds complex electronics, cables and microelectronics for semiconductor, defence, mobility and healthcare clients.
Staff often come from Fontys, TU Eindhoven, Avans and Zuyd, mostly electrical engineering and business.
Has a students and graduates track; employees say you are not just a number there.

open.text: Neways Advanced Applications B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Says it employs people of 143 nationalities.

growth.text: Founded in 1969; says it now has about 3,000 employees across the Netherlands, Germany, Central Europe, the USA and Asia.
Completed its acquisition of Philips Micro Devices.
